missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Круг' is the masculine nominative subject of the passive 'нарисован'. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'на доске' locates it. A clean descriptive sentence.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Круг' is the inanimate accusative direct object of the imperative 'нарисуй', matching the nominative form. 'Ровный' agrees in the masculine accusative. A simple instruction.
Strategic focus: Accusative with в. 'Круг' is the accusative after 'в' showing the formation entered. 'Встать в круг' is the fixed phrase for forming a circle. A common playground scene.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location with special ending. 'Кругу' is the locative form after 'в', taking the stressed -у ending used for the figurative circle of friends. 'Друзей' is the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Круг' is the inanimate accusative object of 'сделал', matching the nominative. 'Сделать круг' means to make a loop. A natural way to describe circling.

Strategic focus: Dative with к. 'Кругу' is the dative after 'к', here meaning a social group. 'Нашему' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'новичок' is the nominative subject. A figurative social use.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Круг' is the inanimate accusative object of 'пробежал', matching the nominative. 'За минуту' gives the time. A natural sporting sentence about laps.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of manner. 'Кругом' is the instrumental showing the shape of the dancing. 'Большим' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A vivid way to describe a group dance.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. 'Круга' follows 'три' in the genitive singular. 'Маленьких' is the genitive plural adjective. A clear numeral-government example.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Круги' is the nominative plural subject of 'расходились'. 'Широкие' agrees in the plural, and 'на воде' sets the scene. A vivid descriptive line.
